day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaNgcwele Yohane de Brébeuf no-Isaac Jogues, abaFundisi, naMahlawulela abo, abaMartire
greeting: Igama likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube kuxolo lobubele lukaThixo uSomandla olusezintliziyweni zenu nonke namhlanje.
penitential:
Nkosi, wena ungumthombo wobubele obungapheliyo, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Kristu, wena usikhanyisela ebumnyameni betsi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Nkosi, wena usibiza ukuba sibe ngabantwana bakho bonaphakade, yiba nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu lapho umhlaba uzolile khona kakhulu, lapho ukujonga kwakho kuwela phezu kwezinto ezincinci ezishiwo ngumntu omthandayo… mhlawumbi yincwadi yezandla ezibhala ikhowudi yekhompyutha, okanye umzobo omdala owenziwe ngabantwana. Cinga ngaloo mzuzu uBenjamin Vo awayehlala ngayo ekhaya, ephindaphinda amagama ezindiza zakhe ezintsha, edala inkampani yamaphupha akhe awayeyibiza ngokuthi 'con chim airlines'. Wayencuma nje ngokukhululeka, egigitheka kancinci xa ethetha ngaloo ndiza yakhe esuka emhlabeni isiwa emafini. Kwakungeyona nje imidlalo yomntwana; kwakuyintliziyo eyayibona ikamva elingenasiphelo, eyayazi ukuba ubomi abuvaliwe apha emhlabeni kuphela. Ben wayengumfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu, enqwenela ukubona izinto zihamba kakuhle kwabo bonke abamngqongileyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usitsalela phezulu kakhulu. Uthi: 'Kodwa uThixo, otyebileyo ngenceba, ngenxa yothando lwakhe olukhulu asithanda ngalo, naxa sasifa ngenxa yeziphoso zethu, wasiphilisa noKristu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Awuthi uThixo wasikhangela kuphela esenza kakuhle. Uthe naxa sasifile ezonweni zethu, naxa umthwalo wawunzima, uthando lwakhe lwaphula udonga lwaqhawula amafu lweza kuthi. UBen wayeyazi le nyaniso ngendlela yakhe ethuleyo. Khumbula ukuba xa wayeneminyaka elishumi nanhlanje, unina noyise bakhumbula umnqweno wakhe wokunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange encinci yakhe ukuncede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi. Kodwa loo mnikelo wangoqobo, lowo mbono womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje kaLuka, sifumana umntu oza kuYesu esithi: 'Mfundisi, tsho kumzalwana wam ukuba abelane nam ngelifa.' UYesu uyaphendula, abuqaphele ubudlelwane obonakeleyo benyama nemali, kwaye uyamxwayisa umntu ngamoyo wamarhubuluza: 'Qaphelani nilumkele bonke ubuhanaha, kuba ubomi bomntu abukho enGCINI yenala yezinto azizuzeyo.' UYesu ulandelisa ngomzekelo waloo mntu otyebileyo owakha izinqala ezinkulu ukuze azigcinele ubutyebi, kodwa uThixo athi kuye: 'Zumnyama, ngobu busuku umphefumlo wakho uya kufunwa kuwe.' Loo mzekelo usixelela ngokucacileyo ngale nto iphilayo phakathi kwethu namhlanje. Ubomi abukho kwezo zinto sizigcinayo; busekubeni sisityebi phambi koThixo.

Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba ukhumbula uBen kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngale roller coaster enayikhwela ngeziganeko ezimnandi, yazi ukuba uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando esingapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sikhulekela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abasehambileyo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu okungunaphakade.
Sikhulekela bonke abasezintlungwini zokulahlekelwa, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba eliqinisekileyo.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliCilekileyo leAltare. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwezinto zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ukukwamukela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngendlela yomoya. Ndiyakwamukela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndibophelela kuwe ngokuphelele; musa ukuvumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Makube uThixo uSomandla onikhuselayo, onipha uxolo olunzulu, kwaye onikhokelela ekukhanyeni kwakhe namhlanje naphakade. Amen.

readings.label: Ukufundwa kokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, nina naba nifile ngenxa yeziphoso zenu nezono zenu, enaza nahlala kuzo kudala ngokuhambisana neli hlabathi, ngokwabaluleki bamandla asezulwini, umoya osebenzayo ngoku kubantu abangaweviyo uMthetho. Thina sonke siphila phakathi kwabo kudala ngokunqwenela inyama yethu, sisenza izinto ezifunwa yinyyama nengqondo, kwaye sasingabantwana bomsindo ngendlela yemvelo nj abanye. Kodwa uThixo, otyebileyo ngenceba, ngenxa yothando lwakhe olukhulu asithanda ngalo, naxa sasifa ngenxa yeziphoso zenu, wasiphilisa noKristu—senzelwe usindiso ngenceba—wasivusa kunye naye, wasihlalisela naye ezulwini kuKristu Yesu, ukuze kwimizi ezayo abonise ubutyebi obungenasiphelo bobubele bakhe ngobubele bakhe kuthi kuKristu Yesu. Kuba nisindisiwe ngenceba ngokholo; kwaye oku akuveli kuni, kuyisipho sikaThixo; akuveli ngemisebenzi, ukuze kungabikho mntu uziqhayisayo. Kuba singumsebenzi wakhe, owadalelwa kuKristu Yesu imisebenzi emihle, eyalungiselelwa nguThixo kwasekuqaleni, ukuze sihambe kuyo.

readings.label: IHubo Lempendulo
readings.text: R. Nkosi usenze, singabakho. Dumisani uYehova, zizwe zonke; khonzani uYehova ngovunjana; zani phambi kwakhe ngengoma yovuyo. R. Nkosi usenze, singabakho. Yazini ukuba uYehova nguThixo; nguye owasenzayo, singabakho; singabantu bakhe, umhlambi awuselayo. R. Nkosi usenze, singabakho. Ngenani emasangweni akhe ngombulelo, nasezintendelekweni zakhe ngendumiso. R. Nkosi usenze, singabakho. Mbuleleni, libongeni igama lakhe, kuba uYehova ulungile; ububele bakhe bunqunyulwa naphakade, nenyani yakhe kwiimio zizukulwana ngezizukulwana. R. Nkosi usenze, singabakho.

readings.label: Ivangeli
readings.text: Omnye esixukwini wathi kuYesu: “Mfundisi, tsho kumzalwana wam ukuba abelane nam ngelifa.” UYesu wamphendula wathi: “Mntu ndini, ngubani owandenza umgwebi okanye umameli phakathi kwenu?” Waza wathi kubantu: “Qaphelani nilumkele bonke ubuhanaha, kuba ubomi bomntu abukho enGCINI yenala yezinto azizuzeyo.” Wabalisa umzekelo kubo, wathi: “Kwakukho umntu otyebileyo owavelisa intsimi yakhe kakhulu. Wazibuza wathi: ‘Ndiya kwenza njani na, ngokuba ndingenandawo yokugcina isivuno sam?’ Wathi: ‘Ndiya kwenza oku: ndiya kuzidiliza izinqala zam, ndakhe ezinkulu kunezo, ndigcine kuzo zonke iinkozo zam nezinto zam, ndize ndithi emphefumlweni wam: Mphefumlo wam, unezinto ezininzi ezibekelwe iminyaka emininzi; phumla, udle, usele, uvuye.’ Kodwa uThixo wathi kuye: ‘Msweli-lwazi! Ngobu busuku umphefumlo wakho uya kufunwa kuwe; zona izinto ozilungisileyo ziya kuba ngekabani na?’ Kunjalo ke kulowo uzigcinela ubutyebi, engatyebanga kuThixo.”

day: Memorial of Saints John de Brébeuf and Isaac Jogues, Priests, and Companions, Martyrs

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
